rules.rationale: This is the terminating base equation for the recursively defined primeFrom mathematical summary: once D squared exceeds N, no remaining candidate divisor is in the represented search range.
This equation defines the false case of primeFrom when the current in-range candidate D divides N; it is a defining branch of the summary, not an independently asserted number-theory fact.
This is the recursive equation for primeFrom, advancing the definition from a non-dividing in-range candidate D to D plus one.
This equation defines isPrime to be false below 2, supplying one branch of the named primality summary used by the specification.
This equation defines isPrime for inputs at least 2 by expanding it to the primeFrom recurrence beginning with candidate divisor 2.
This structural helper equation defines chooseVal on true by selecting and wrapping X; it merely expands a named proof-result term.
This structural helper equation defines chooseVal on false by selecting and wrapping Y; it merely expands a named proof-result term.
